# Pinterest Türkiye (tr.pinterest.com)

> > Turkish Pinterest platform featuring visual discovery for DIY crafts, wallpapers, art tutorials, fashion inspiration, and home decor ideas.

This is the Turkish localized version of Pinterest, serving millions of users searching for creative inspiration across categories like Resimler (images), DIY projects, iPhone wallpapers, painting tutorials, and aesthetic content. The platform includes both curated idea pages and user-generated boards featuring Turkish, Russian, and international content.

## Key Topics

- Pinterest visual discovery
- Turkish content (Resimler, Etkinlikler)
- DIY crafts & painting tutorials
- iPhone wallpapers & aesthetic backgrounds
- Beginner art & knitting tutorials
- Instagram & TikTok inspiration
- Disney & Hello Kitty characters
- Fashion outfit combinations
- Home decor & interior design
- Sticker & planner designs
- Acrylic & minimalist painting
- Crochet & fiber arts
- Turkish user boards
- Video tutorials
- Tumblr aesthetic
